name: Deflection (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School abjuration; Level antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, magus 1, paladin 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

This spell grants the target emergency protection. The target gains a +5 deflection bonus to their AC against the next attack made against them in the duration.
